purpose: Defines test norms, the mapping from requirements to design and acceptance verification points, cross-cutting scenarios, and the approval status of the design.
summary: State machine tests cover every transition table row, rejecting guard failures and undefined events
Missing reference targets do not block candidate confirmation and are recorded as absent
check-impact test cases for read-only behavior, hash comparison, repeated notification, and no chained notification
check-links test cases for inline links with DLID titles and recorded hash word form
Deterministic processing has separate unit tests for parsing, ID handling, resolution, hashing and validation
Table maps requirements to primary design documents and main verification points
Seven cross-cutting scenarios: initial build, move, content change, failure, multiple keys, out-of-scope references, later references
Approval status states that all open requirement items are decided and the design is approved
